title: Extract wolfSSL provider into src/providers/wolfssl/
description:
Create crypto2dev_wolfssl.ko: a new kernel module that wraps wolfCrypt calls in the algo_ops vtable and registers them with crypto2dev.ko.

Files to create:
- src/providers/wolfssl/wolfssl_provider.c: module_init calls crypto2dev_register_provider(), module_exit calls crypto2dev_unregister_provider()
- wolfssl_aes_cbc.c, wolfssl_aes_gcm.c, wolfssl_sha.c, wolfssl_hmac.c, wolfssl_cmac.c, wolfssl_rsa.c, wolfssl_ecc.c

Each file implements crypto2dev_algo_ops for its algorithm. fips_gate callback = wolfCrypt_GetStatus_fips check.

All FIPS checklist rules still apply inside each ops implementation:
- sess_init: kzalloc ctx, wc_XxxInit, wc_XxxSetKey
- sess_free: wc_XxxFree, memzero_explicit, kfree
- update/finalize: mutex, wc_Xxx calls, return code translation

MODULE_SOFTDEP: pre: wolfcrypt crypto2dev

Depends on: provider header issue, registry issue
